nodes.title: SG-6.3 Fix App and GameScreen split unit tests
nodes.body:
Context: App.tsx (23 lines) delegates to GameScreen.tsx (41 lines), and the split is done. Three tests fail: the Bookshelf click test and the Search test in tests/appFlow.test.tsx, and the remount test in tests/app.test.tsx. The product code is correct. PhaserHost now writes the canvas layout to uiStore via setCanvasLayout, and ObjectOverlay renders only when canvasLayout exists. tests/appFlow.test.tsx still mocks PhaserHost with an obsolete onLayout prop that GameScreen never passes, so the layout is never set and no action buttons render. tests/app.test.tsx looks up the button named 'Search', but ObjectOverlay labels it 'Search Bookshelf'. Expected result: all three tests pass, with no test deleted or skipped and no rendered change. Why: this closes SG-6.3.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the playing view, when objectClick for bookshelf is emitted, then Inspect, Push, Search and Leave Bookshelf buttons render (appFlow test).
- Given Search Bookshelf is clicked, then Story history contains 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.' (appFlow test).
- Given a played game is unmounted and App remounts and Begin is clicked, then the history and the Inventory region are restored (app.test).
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines, and App.tsx and GameScreen.tsx are unchanged in output.


## Scope
- In scope: tests/appFlow.test.tsx PhaserHost mock
- In scope: tests/app.test.tsx remount test button lookup
- In scope: confirming GameScreen and PhaserHost wiring
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: api/client.ts
- Out of scope: new features
- Preserve: Rendered output
- Preserve: PhaserHost writing canvasLayout to the store
- Preserve: All other tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No test is deleted or skipped
- Tests mock only Phaser, the API client and storage
- api/client.ts calls and payloads unchanged
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/frontend


## Definition of done
- The three failing tests pass
- No test removed or skipped
- Typecheck passes


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Object click shows action buttons and Search records the hidden door in the App flow
nodes.body:
Context: GameScreen renders PhaserHost with only scenes, and the real host calls useUiStore.setCanvasLayout. appFlow.test.tsx mocks PhaserHost with an onLayout prop that nothing passes, so ObjectOverlay returns null. Desired behavior: the stand-in sets canvasLayout in the store on mount, like tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx already does. Expected result: the Bookshelf and Search tests pass. Why: the test then matches the production wiring.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the playing view and a store canvasLayout of left 0, top 0, zoom 1, dpr 1, when objectClick bookshelf is emitted, then Inspect, Push, Search and Leave Bookshelf buttons are present.
- Given Search Bookshelf is clicked, then the Story history list contains 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.'


## Scope
- In scope: tests/appFlow.test.tsx mock
- Out of scope: src changes
- Preserve: Other appFlow tests


## Technical constraints
- Tests mock only Phaser
- No test deleted or skipped


## Definition of done
- Both appFlow tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Remounted App restores history and Inventory using the real action label
nodes.body:
Context: ObjectOverlay sets aria-label to '<action> <object>', so the Search button is named 'Search Bookshelf'. app.test.tsx calls getByRole('button', {name:'Search'}), which matches nothing. Desired behavior: use the name 'Search Bookshelf' and make sure the layout exists. Expected result: the test passes and asserts the restored history and Inventory region. Why: the test then reflects behaviour.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given objectClick bookshelf and a click on Search Bookshelf, when App is unmounted, remounted and Begin clicked, then Story history shows 'A hidden door swings open behind the books.'
- Given the remount, then the Inventory region is present.


## Scope
- In scope: tests/app.test.tsx remount test
- Out of scope: src changes
- Preserve: Other app.test tests


## Technical constraints
- Tests mock only Phaser
- No test deleted or skipped


## Definition of done

nodes.summary: Fix the PhaserHost mock in appFlow so the two failing tests pass.
nodes.description: Rewrite the PhaserHost mock in tests/appFlow.test.tsx to set the layout in the store, following tests/appObjectClick.test.tsx.
technical_constraints: Mock only Phaser, the API client and storage

steps.action: Replace the stand-in with PhaserHost: () => { useEffect(() => { useUiStore.getState().setCanvasLayout({ left: 0, top: 0, zoom: 1, dpr: 1 }); }, []); return null; }. Import useUiStore inside the factory with await import('../src/store/uiStore'). Remove the onLayout prop and its type.
steps.code: PhaserHost: () => { useEffect(() => { useUiStore.getState().setCanvasLayout({ left: 0, top: 0, zoom: 1, dpr: 1 }); }, []); return null; }
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx

steps.action: Add useUiStore.setState(useUiStore.getInitialState(), true) so the layout does not leak between tests. The mock effect sets it again on each mount.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/appFlow.test.tsx
steps.expected: All appFlow tests pass, including 'Bookshelf hotspot' and 'Search adds the hidden door text'.
